selection_objective: Maximized validation Dice score while minimizing validation False Positive Rate (FPR)

audit_finding.operational_safety_verdict: Threshold 0.50 was deterministically selected strictly using the 7 validation scenes. However, with a validation FPR of 25.26%, threshold 0.50 is NOT operationally safe for standalone automated alerting. Model V4 must remain classified as EXPERIMENTAL, requiring external MetOcean wind and AIS drift fusion.
